_note: Decision engine configuration for Phase 2. All decision rules are config-driven — no hardcoding in code.

rules._note: Core decision rules. ambiguityRequiresValidation is the primary demo-visible toggle.
rules._noteContextOverride: If true and Approach 1 confidence >= contextOverrideMinScore, REQUIRE_VALIDATION is downgraded to AUTO_PROCESS

validation._note: Demo validation settings. demoAutoResolveMs controls how long before mock validation auto-resolves.
validation._noteHold: If true, any REQUIRE_VALIDATION leg holds the entire trip bill until all validations resolve
